sections.heading: What is Insurance?
sections.text: Insurance is protection against financial loss in unexpected situations.

sections.heading: Why Insurance is Important
sections.text: It protects savings, reduces risk, and provides financial security.

sections.heading: Key Terms
sections.text: Premium, policy, claim, coverage, sum assured.

sections.heading: Types of Insurance
sections.text:
- Health insurance
- Life insurance
- Motor insurance
- Property insurance

sections.heading: How it Works
sections.text: Pay premium → risk occurs → claim → receive compensation.

sections.heading: Common Mistakes
sections.text:
- Low coverage
- Ignoring terms
- Delaying purchase
